weight_bytes_source: HF official fixed-revision sibling metadata, no weights fetched
wheel_size_method: HEAD Content-Length for 51 exact resolved wheels; no wheel bodies downloaded
three_venvs: Installed package trees are independent; shared pip/HF caches can deduplicate downloads but do not assume venv hardlinks. Installed bytes unmeasured.
disk_formula: weight cache (61,969,104,754 bytes) + 3 installed envs + one shared wheel cache + real selected data/images + optional retrieval index + results + staging/temp/headroom
planning_headroom: For preliminary storage reservation only, budget 8-15 GiB per environment and >=20 GiB staging/headroom in addition to exact weights, unknown full data/index/results. These are estimates, not measured installed sizes or guarantees.
total_generation_calls_formula: quality question-runs + all preflight/development calls + performance sample_count*repeat_count per task + >=3 unscored warmups per newly warmed executed task + explicit retries
GPU_hours_method: Measure representative per-model single/multi image development batches, account load/warmup/retry plus retrieval only if same-hardware interface is present. Do not extrapolate from synthetic or six-row results.
